subject: History

questions.text: For each of the following items choose the best answer from the given alternatives.
The collection of public documents is called: Museums Archives Archaeology Oral traditions Choose Answer : - -
The chronological order of events is usually shown in the following EXCEPT : Time chart Time line Family tree Carbon 14 Choose Answer : - -

The following are the stages in evolution of man: Zinjanthropus, Homo Erectus, Homo Sapiens, Homo Habilis Chimpanzee, Homo Erectus, Zinjanthropus Chimpanzee, Zinjanthropus, Homo Habilis, Homo Erectus, Homo Sapiens Modern Apes, Homo Sapiens, Chimpanzee, Zinjanthropus Choose Answer : - -
The basic needs which man constantly struggles to obtain are: Water, food and clothes Relationship, love and peace Air, love and food Food, shelter and clothes Choose Answer : - -
The following is one of the methods used to obtain gold in African societies: Shaft and panning methods Pottery and ornaments Ornaments and shaft Panning method and pottery Choose Answer : - -

were the main participants in long distance trade in East Africa: Yao, Nyamwezi and Kamba Imbangala, Vimbundu and Arabs Ngoni, Tuareg, Arabs and Mazrui Yao, Barbaig, Arabs and Mandinka Choose Answer : - -

Local trade among African societies became possible when: One society became more powerful than others Iron tools had increased People produced less than their needs People could produce more than their needs Choose Answer : - -

One reason for the Dutch settlement at the Cape in 1652 was to: Create Dutch empire in South Africa; Defeat Asians and Europeans who monopolized the Indian Ocean; Prepare a refreshment station for Dutch merchants from India; Place South Africa in the World of Capitalism Choose Answer : - -

The social factors for interaction among the people of Africa were: Migration, intermarriage and the need to search for new areas; Trade, war and migration; Language, migration and population increase; Trade, intermarriage, language and population increase. Choose Answer : - -
The earliest social organization from which each society has passed through is: Slavery Socialism Feudalism Communalism Choose Answer : - -
